decisions: Start every dependency-ready task with non-overlapping owned files.
No fixed /gowork worker cap; actual infrastructure may queue execution.
Every simultaneous task gets an isolated branch and worktree.
One integration owner combines verified results.
Automatically split clear independent builds and send compact child context.
Archive a worker thread only after its result is verified, integrated, and passes the combined check; keep every attention-needed thread open, preserve a reopenable link, and never delete or lock it.
